cards.card_text: Bartimaeus calls Jesus “Rabboni” and asks Him to let him ___ again.
cards.verse_text: “Rabboni,” said the blind man, “let me see again.”
cards.snippet: “Rabboni,” said the blind man, “let me see again.”

cards.card_text: She turns and says to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
cards.verse_text: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
cards.snippet: …said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to Him in Hebrew, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
